GameConditionDef.label: void surge
GameConditionDef.description: Something vast beneath the crust has overeaten and is belching it back up. A sweet pink haze hangs over everything, and anyone outdoors soaks it up - building void exposure that slowly fattens them. Roofs keep it out.
GameConditionDef.descriptionFuture: a sweet, fattening haze will hang over [map_definite] for [gameConditionDuration_duration]
GameConditionDef.endMessage: The void surge subsides. The pink haze thins and settles.
GameConditionDef.letterText:
Something vast beneath the crust has overeaten, and it is belching it back up.

A sweet pink haze is settling over the whole area. Anyone who spends time outdoors will soak it up - their void exposure builds the longer they stay out, and the more exposed they are, the faster they fatten. It fades once they're back under a roof.

It should blow over in a day or two.

HediffDef.label: void exposure
HediffDef.description: A sweet, heavy haze soaked up from a void surge. The more of it someone has taken in, the faster it fattens them and the hungrier they get. It fades over a couple of days under a roof.
